mechanism.claim: Within each completed Binance eight-hour derivatives cycle, premium-index path activity relative to BTC realized variation separates spot-led continuation from derivatives-heavy overreaction. Follow the completed BTC direction in the lower relative-activity tail and fade it in the upper tail for the next eight hours.
mechanism.side: BTC cycle direction in the lower relative-activity tail and its negative in the upper tail
mechanism.why_distinct: HVIPRAPR is an intraday eight-hour cross-market efficiency state. It is not the rejected daily HVPRAPR clock, uses no daily session aggregation, funding, OI, spot table, alt, fitted outcome, prior event rows, or promoted control.
mechanism.why_suited_to_volatile_regimes: completed eight-hour BTC realized variation must rank at least 0.65 causally
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: tail-qualified intraday premium-efficiency states at exact derivatives-cycle boundaries are absent from Gross9 primitives

features.premium_path: 480 exact unique bars_binance_premium BTCUSDT one-minute closes [D-8h,D), finite signed values
features.premium_total_variation: sum(abs(close[i]-close[i-1])) over 479 within-block pairs, strict positive
features.btc_path: 480 exact coherent bars_binance BTCUSDT one-minute OHLC rows over the same block
features.btc_realized_variation: sqrt(sum squared one-minute log(close/open) returns), strict positive
features.causal_ranks: strict-prior midranks of relative activity and BTC variation over at most 270 earlier source-valid cycles, minimum 180; current excluded
features.relative_activity_tails: lower rank<=0.25 or upper rank>=0.75; middle ineligible
features.routing: lower tail follows btc_return; upper tail fades btc_return
features.eligible: source valid, either relative-activity tail, BTC variation rank>=0.65, and strict nonzero BTC return
features.side: sign(btc_return) in lower tail and -sign(btc_return) in upper tail

clock.reservation: global half-open; exit first on equal entry
clock.funding: not a signal input; exact held settlements only after source and Gross9 pass

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding, 6bp base and 10bp stress per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

source_plan.btc: Postgres bars_binance BTCUSDT exact coherent 1m OHLC
source_plan.execution_prices: sealed until source support and Gross9 pass

research_boundary.classification: exploratory discovery; not fresh confirmatory evidence

stopping_rule: terminal first failure; no source, block, relative-activity tails, variation rank, side, clock, hold, subset, threshold, comparator, or control repair
